answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 35752 Country: India Title: I want to know whether it is permissible to eat while Janabah or not? Question: I want to know whether it is permissible to eat while Janabah or not? Answer ID: 35752 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 14/5/L=1433) It is lawful to eat and drink in the state of janabah. However, it is better to wash one's hands and mouth before eating and drinking. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
